instructions.title: How to Play
rules: The numbers are drawn one by one.
You can place a number in any open position.
Once placed, numbers cannot be moved.
Position 1 is for the lowest, 14 for the highest.
instructions.gameOver: If a number breaks the ascending order, or no valid slots remain:
instructions.secret: Place all 14 numbers and you may discover the meaning of life, the universe, and everything.

scoreIndicator.notSaving: Log in to save your scores
